title: Musk says Nvidia will lose 'critical' deals without Jensen Huang
gist: Elon Musk warned (via Reuters, Nov 14) that Nvidia could lose critical deals without Jensen Huang because many supply-chain arrangements rested on personal agreements rather than written contracts. The post treats this as a key-person risk warning rather than evidence of lost business, and the poster, claiming insider knowledge, judges the risk minimal while speculating Huang could return in an emeritus-type role.
